one_line: A one-line question on screen over held products, one per 2.5 s, with a comment-for-link ask in the caption.

q1_hook.what: 0:00 top-down on a dark wood table: a Disney Stitch paint-kit box with a half-painted blue figure in its window. No speech. Two-line yellow-green text from the first frame: "איזו דמות הייתם צובעים קודם?"
q1_hook.why: A question the viewer can answer at once is the headline from frame one (H1, T3), and the half-painted figure shows what the kit makes (H2). There is no voice or face (H4), and the hook is only on screen, not heard (H6). The question is never answered inside the Reel (H5).

beats.what: Stitch kit box, half-painted blue figure; the question text appears
beats.why: The question frames the next 10 s as a choice

beats.what: Hard cut to a metallic bear kit box held at the lower edge
beats.why: A second option keeps the choice going

beats.what: Cut to a duck kit box with orange, pink and gold paint
beats.why: A new colour set resets attention

beats.what: Cut to a Hello Kitty kit box, half-painted pink; the Reel ends
beats.why: Last option, then a quick stop

q2_flow.interaction_prompts: On screen: the pick-one question. Caption: guesses for each family member, "אעדכן בסטורי אם צדקתי", and a comment ask for a link and coupon.
q2_flow.why: A new box every 2.5 s with identical framing is easy to follow and keeps the middle moving (R3, E2). At 10 s there is no sag (R1, R2), but there is no payoff either: the question stays open and the answer lives in a story (R4).

q3_cta.what: None in the video. Caption, last line: "ואם אתן כבר מכירות ורוצות אחד תגיבו לסרטון אשלח לכן קישור לרכישה וקופון ❤️". No comment word. An earlier line promises an explainer video in the evening.
q3_cta.why: A comment that delivers a real link and coupon has a purpose (C2, C3), but it names no keyword and sits in the last caption line, below "more" (C6). The explainer promise and the on-screen question add other asks (C1). The video itself ends with nothing said or shown.

q4_shown.what: Four paint-and-pour kit boxes in turn, one per 2.5 s: Stitch, a metallic bear, a duck, Hello Kitty. Each window shows a half-painted figure, the box shows 3 paint bottles. No painting, no child, no price, no screen recording.
q4_shown.why: The printed half-painted sample tells viewers what the kit gives without a demo (H2, S1), and hands at the lower edge carry the Reel without a face (S4). It is the maker's printed sample, not a result the creator made.

q5_edit.what: 4 shots in about 10 s, about 2.5 s each, hard cuts at about 2.5, 5 and 7.6 s, same top-down framing. No speed change. One text block for the whole Reel. No voice. Ends on the last box, no end card.
q5_edit.why: Even cuts with fixed framing give a steady pace (E2). The headline never changes, which suits a one-question Reel (T3). With no voice and no changing text, nothing new is said after the first second (E4). The 10 s length ends cleanly (E8).

q6_topic.what: A family painting activity: which of four character kits each family member would pick. It serves parents looking for something to do together with the kids.
q6_topic.why: Characters children already know make the pick-one question easy to answer (R6). The caption's guesses for daughter, son and husband are a small family story (K2) that invites viewers to compare with their own home. It targets no milestone, gift moment or worry (K6, K7).

q7_filmed.what: Top-down on a dark wood table, the box filling the frame and held at the lower edge by hands from 0:03. Camera looks fixed (same framing across cuts). Even soft light. No face, no child.
q7_filmed.why: Top-down, box facing the viewer, hands only, is the simple no-child setup (F5, S4), and the box art is large and sharp (F4, F7). The headline sits at the top edge of the frame and runs over the box logos (F2, T4).

q8_text.on_screen: One two-line headline in yellow-green bold with a thin outline, centred near the top, held for the whole Reel: "איזו דמות" / "הייתם צובעים קודם?". It crosses the logo area of each box from 0:03. English box text otherwise. No price, no CTA text.
q8_text.caption: "אירגנתי לנו פעילות משפחתית להיום!" About 60 words: family guesses, "אעדכן בסטורי אם צדקתי", an evening explainer promise, a comment ask for link and coupon. No hashtags, no disclosure.
q8_text.why: The headline is short and readable from frame one (T3, T5), but yellow-green fades over the olive and red parts of the boxes and sits at the top edge (T4, T5). The caption has no searchable keywords or hashtags (T7), and the co-author collaboration is not disclosed in words (T8).

weak_points: No painting or result shown, so the experience is only implied; the question is not answered in the video; no voice; the ask is hidden in the caption; the collaboration is not disclosed; headline over box logos.
lumebook_takeaway: Lay four LumeBook covers top-down one at a time, 2.5 s each, phone fixed overhead, with a one-line pick-one question on screen.
not_verified: Audio: the transcript shows only "תודה רבה" over 10 s, so no speech; music or noise not established. Whether the kits were gifted or paid, the coupon value, and who palphot is. Cut times follow 1 s frames and the first pass. Text contrast judged by eye. No correction to src/coded.
